page: HTML Helper for HTML template literals. Import: {Hono} from 'hono', {html, raw} from 'hono/html'. html tagged template literal for HTML strings. Escapes values automatically via ${...}. raw() for unescaped HTML insertion. HtmlEscapedString type allows functional components. c.html() returns HTML response. Use cases: inline scripts, snippets in JSX, components without JSX. Security: auto-escapes interpolations, raw() requires manual escaping. Performance: template literals faster than memo. Composition: supports props, children embedding. VS Code: lit-html extension for syntax highlighting. vim: vim-jsx-pretty for highlighting. Questions: How to write HTML? How to embed values? Hello ${name}

...
`. Props pattern: (props) => html`${props.title}`. HtmlEscapedString return type. Performance: template literals faster than JSX for large elements. Questions: How to use? How to embed values? In JSX? Component pattern?

raw() for unescaped HTML. const result = html`

${raw(name)}

`. Embeds content without escaping. Use case: pre-formatted HTML. Security: developer responsible for escaping. Example: raw() passes through & and " characters. Questions: When to use raw()? How escaping works? Security risks?
